purpose: Brainstorming concept sheets; not production sprites or approved mascot selection.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original mascot exploration sheet for ClearVest, a calm investing education web app for beginners. This is an early design concept, not finished production artwork.
Primary request: Create a polished character design sheet for "Cove", an original small curious otter companion that can peek above the bottom-left edge of a website. Approachable and reassuring for adults, charming without looking like a children's game.
Subject: one consistent rounded otter with a broad compact head, tiny rounded ears, cream muzzle, navy expressive pupils, very simplified warm grey-brown body, little paws and a minimal cobalt blue vest. Eyes must remain legible at 56px icon size. No fur detail; clean silhouette, restrained soft 2.5D shading and matte surfaces, crisp shapes suitable for later vector animation. Character identity identical across poses.
Composition: landscape 3:2 concept board on pure white, generous empty space. Large hero pose on the left, half-body otter rising just above a thin pale grey horizontal page-edge line, two paws gently resting on the edge, eyes glancing casually to one side. Right side contains three smaller clearly separated expressions vertically: attentive with a tiny head tilt; thinking with one paw under chin and pupils upward; ready with a small reassuring smile and one paw open. At the bottom, a small deployment sketch places a tiny version next to the navy words "Ask about your money" on a light #F5F7FA header. Clean professional design presentation, not a busy infographic.
Palette: ClearVest navy #172B46, cobalt #2457C5, white #FFFFFF, cool grey #DDE3EB with natural muted otter body colors. Keep background flat white. Text only: "Cove" and small labels "Peek", "Listen", "Think", "Ready", and the quoted header. Simple sans serif typography.
Avoid: dollar signs, coins, money bags, stock arrows, trading gestures, trophies, robot antennas, goggles, glossy toy plastic, huge anime eyes, teeth, decorative gradients, fake chat paragraphs, existing mascot likenesses, watermarks.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original mascot exploration sheet for ClearVest, a calm investing education web app for beginners. Early concept, not final production artwork.
Primary request: Create a polished character design sheet for "Scout", an original small observant shorebird companion that peeks above the bottom-left edge of a website. Adult-friendly, calm, clever and approachable.
Subject: one consistent compact round shorebird with a navy-blue head and small soft crest, white cheek/belly area, very small muted golden beak, expressive visible dark pupils in restrained light eye shapes, rounded wings. Not an owl, not a penguin, no clothing or accessories. Simple unmistakable silhouette legible at 56px, clean matte 2.5D illustration, almost vector-like, very restrained shading, no detailed feathers.
Composition: landscape 3:2 white concept board with generous negative space. Large hero pose left: head and tiny rounded wings peeking over a thin pale grey horizontal page-edge line, eyes looking sideways with relaxed curiosity. Right side three smaller separated expressions vertically: listening with slight head tilt; thinking with wing under beak and eyes up; ready with a subtle pleased expression and small raised wing. Bottom small deployment sketch shows a tiny mascot beside the navy words "Ask about your money" on a cool light #F5F7FA header. Professional character design presentation, not a full app mockup.
Palette: navy #172B46, cobalt #2457C5, white #FFFFFF, cool grey #DDE3EB; muted golden beak only. Flat white background. Text only: "Scout" and small labels "Peek", "Listen", "Think", "Ready", and quoted header. Simple sans serif.
Constraints: identical recognizable character in every pose, eyes easy to animate independently. No coins, financial symbols, chart arrows, sunglasses, hats, exaggerated cartoon smiles, robotic features, glitter, glow, decoration, existing mascot likeness, watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original mascot exploration sheet for ClearVest, a calm investing education web app for beginners. Early concept, not a finished UI asset.
Primary request: Create a polished character design sheet for "Pebble", an original small expressive river-stone creature that peeks above the bottom-left edge of a website. Quiet, thoughtful, friendly, grown-up, distinctly sculptural and minimal.
Subject: one consistent softly asymmetric rounded pale-blue river pebble with two expressive dark navy eyes and small movable pupils, a tiny subtle mouth, two short rounded arms with no fingers. Matte mineral-like appearance with an almost flat clean 2.5D illustration finish, no speckled texture. Flattened slightly wide silhouette with one subtly taller rounded side; no ears, antenna, screen face, clothing or accessories. Must be recognizable and charming at 56px.
Composition: landscape 3:2 design board on flat pure white. Large hero pose at left: upper portion of the pebble and small arms peeking over a thin pale grey horizontal page-edge line, relaxed eyes glancing sideways. Right side three smaller expressions vertically: attentive with a slight lean; thinking with eyes glancing up and one little arm touching its side; ready with a tiny reassuring smile and small raised arm. Bottom a small deployment sketch places a tiny mascot next to the navy words "Ask about your money" on a #F5F7FA header. Lots of whitespace, restrained professional design presentation.
Palette: soft pale blue body #DCE8FA with cobalt #2457C5 at the underside, navy eyes #172B46, white #FFFFFF and light grey #DDE3EB. Text only: "Pebble", small pose labels "Peek", "Listen", "Think", "Ready", and quoted header. Clean sans serif.
Avoid: translucent glass, glowing orbs, gradients in background, generic AI sparkle icon, jelly/slime texture, dollar signs, coins, charts, eyebrows suggesting anger, big teeth, huge anime eyes, busy decoration, existing mascot likeness, watermark.
